name: PawLedger
tagline: The operating system for hands-on pet care businesses.
positioning: PawLedger unifies bookings, pet records, and staff scheduling so groomers, daycares, and boarding facilities run every shift from one calm dashboard.

hero.h1: Run your pet care business without the front-desk chaos.
hero.sub: PawLedger keeps every booking, vaccination record, and staff shift in one place—so you spend less time chasing paperwork and more time with the animals.

features.title: Pet profiles that stay current
features.description: Store vaccination dates, feeding notes, and behavior flags on each pet. Reminders nudge owners before a shot lapses, so you never turn a dog away at check-in.

features.title: Bookings that don't double-book
features.description: Set kennel counts, groom-table slots, and staff ratios once. PawLedger blocks overbooking automatically and fills cancellations from your waitlist.

features.title: Shift scheduling per seat
features.description: Give each groomer, handler, and receptionist their own login, availability, and task list. Everyone sees today's roster the moment they clock in.

features.title: Deposits and no-show protection
features.description: Take card deposits at booking and auto-charge no-show fees to your policy. Fewer empty slots, fewer awkward phone calls.

features.title: Owner reminders on autopilot
features.description: Text and email confirmations, pickup nudges, and rebooking prompts go out on schedule—branded with your business name, not ours.

features.title: Clear numbers every morning
features.description: See revenue, occupancy, and repeat-visit rates by location without exporting a single spreadsheet.

testimonials.quote: We were juggling a paper calendar and three group texts. PawLedger put our whole grooming schedule in one screen, and no-shows dropped the first month once deposits kicked in.
testimonials.name: Renata Alvarez

testimonials.quote: Adding seats for new handlers takes a minute, and each one only sees the pets on their shift. Onboarding a weekend hire used to eat my whole Friday.
testimonials.name: Marcus Deel

testimonials.quote: The vaccination reminders alone paid for it. We stopped turning away dogs at drop-off because owners actually get the nudge before their records expire.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For single-operator groomers and sitters getting organized.
For multi-staff daycares and grooming shops running daily shifts.
For boarding groups and franchises across several locations.

homepage.footerBlurb: PawLedger helps hands-on pet care businesses run every shift from one dependable dashboard. Built for the people who actually clean the kennels.
